about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the tranquility of Patch of Heaven, a charming 2D pixel art nursery simulator designed for your relaxation. Here, your plants never die, allowing you to enjoy gardening without pressure. The main goal isn't to win, but to find an oasis of calm. Furthermore, Patch of Heaven doesn't have a traditional background, allowing you to use it as a relaxing widget on your desktop while you work or do other tasks.

Key Features:

  • Stress-Free Gardening: Dedicate yourself to watering, transplanting, moving, and pruning your plants at your own pace. Watch them flourish and grow under your care.

  • Your Multitasking Oasis: Enjoy the beauty of your nursery directly on your desktop. By not having a full-screen background, Patch of Heaven can function as a widget, offering you a touch of nature and calm while you remain productive.

  • Prosper and Expand: Once your plants are fully grown, prune them and sell the excess for profit. Use your earnings to acquire seeds for more exotic and rare plants, which in turn will offer greater rewards.

  • Personalized Sanctuary: Decorate your nursery радио your liking. Place your plants wherever you prefer and complement the space with a variety of adornments available in the shop, from adorable rabbits and atmospheric lanterns to comfortable chairs and tables.

  • Designed for Well-being: Enjoy a carefully selected color palette and a soundtrack composed in 432 Hz, elements that, according to studies, contribute to reducing anxiety and stress levels, creating a truly relaxing experience.

In Patch of Heaven, your sole objective is to cultivate your own corner of peace, whether as an immersive experience or as a serene companion in your day-to-day life. Create the nursery of your dreams and let serenity flourish!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 - 6th gen
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics 2 GB or more
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: win11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 - 6th gen
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics 2 GB or more
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
